The [[Lamuir system/Legends|Lamuir system]] contained [[Lamuir IV]]. It was in the [[Freeworlds Territory]] of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], on the [[Shapani Bypass/Legends|Shapani Bypass]].
